tolerance: ±0,01 dB on R′w, DnT,w, R′A, DA, DnT,w + Ctr, RA,50, Rw of the separating element and on every path value; exact dominant path, refusals and target verdicts; the printed Annex L.1.4 values within ±0,5 dB (R′w) and ±0,15 dB (paths, printed from rounded intermediate values); the page path (preset → state → engine → DnT,w tile) for every preset case

External anchor: the printed R′w = 57,0 dB and the 13 printed path values of Annex L.1.4 (Table L.10). r3-fix rules written from the clauses, not from the JS: Fig. E.7 geometry (light separating wall → Ff = K24 along the continuous homogeneous element, Fd / Df = K12; heavy separating element crossed by a light leaf → Ff = K13), Formula (10) in-situ floor of Kij, E.3.4 load classes. Shared reading with the engine (labelled on the page): C of the mass law −1 / −2 dB, ΔRA = ΔRw of linings in the A-weighted run, flexible interlayers = joints on both sides of the junction line (Ff crosses two joints, Fd / Df one), load not given → Cc 15, flanking element areas taken = S of the separating element in the Formula (10) floor, the flanking element continues through the junction, pass / fail on the value rounded to 0,1 dB.
